items.exampleEn: Cost is only one aspect of the problem.
items.exampleZh: 費用只是這個問題的其中一個面向。

items.exampleEn: Her acceptance of the job offer made everyone happy.
items.exampleZh: 她接受了這份工作，讓大家都很高興。

items.exampleEn: Volunteering is a meaningful way to spend your weekend.
items.exampleZh: 當志工是度過週末很有意義的方式。

items.exampleEn: How he got the money is still a puzzle to me.
items.exampleZh: 他是怎麼拿到那筆錢的，對我來說仍是個謎。

items.exampleEn: She accepted the prize on behalf of her team.
The weather was favorable for our trip.
items.exampleZh: 天氣對我們的旅行很有利。

items.exampleEn: There was a disagreement about where to eat.
items.exampleZh: 大家對要去哪裡吃飯意見不合。

items.exampleEn: You will get a confirmation email after you book.
items.exampleZh: 預訂之後，你會收到一封確認信。

items.sentenceEn: The weather was favorable, so the flight left on time.
items.sentenceZh: 天氣條件良好，所以班機準時起飛。

items.audioEn: I'm calling on behalf of Ms. Wang to change the meeting time.
items.audioZh: 我代表王小姐打電話來更改開會時間。

items.sentenceEn: We had a small disagreement, but we are still good friends.
items.sentenceZh: 我們有過一點小爭執，但仍然是好朋友。

items.sentenceEn: This puzzle has one thousand pieces.

items.stemEn: Please wait for ____ of your booking before you pay.
items.stemZh: 付款前請先等候您的訂位確認。

items.stemEn: Helping others makes my life more ____.
items.stemZh: 幫助別人讓我的生活更有意義。

items.passageEn: Our team had a long meeting about a new product. At first, there was some disagreement, because each person focused on a different aspect: price, design, or safety. How to please everyone was a real puzzle. In the end, our manager spoke on behalf of the whole team and asked the director for help. The director's response was favorable, and we got confirmation of the budget the next day. The acceptance of our plan was a meaningful moment for all of us.
items.passageZh: 我們團隊為了一項新產品開了很長的會。一開始大家意見有些分歧，因為每個人關注的面向不同：價格、設計或安全。要怎麼讓每個人都滿意，真是個難題。最後，經理代表整個團隊向總監求助。總監的回應很正面，隔天我們就收到預算的確認。我們的計畫被接受，對大家來說是很有意義的時刻。

questions.questionZh: 一開始大家為什麼意見不合？
options: 預算根本就不夠大家用
大家開了一天會都太累了

referenceEn: On behalf of the company, I welcome everyone.
I would like to welcome you all on behalf of the company.
rubricZh: on behalf of＋人、團體等，表示「代表⋯」
on behalf of 可放在句首、句尾等位置
「歡迎大家」可寫 welcome everyone、welcome you all 等

items.promptZh: 這張舊照片對我奶奶來說很有意義。
referenceEn: This old photo is very meaningful to my grandmother.
For my grandma, this old photo is very meaningful.
rubricZh: 用 meaningful 表示「有意義的」（例如 is very meaningful to…；寫 means a lot to 也正確）
「對…來說」可寫，例如 to my grandmother、for my grandma 等
